```{r}
#mode sizes n_k



TT_SVD_reconstruct <- function(list_cores) {
  dims <- length(list_cores)
  
  reconstruct <- with(list_cores, nm_prod)
  
  reconstruct <- nm_prod(list_cores[[1]], list_cores[[2]], 2, 1)
  
  for(i in 3:dims) {
    reconstruct <- nm_prod(reconstruct, list_cores[[i]], i, 1)
  }
  reconstruct
}

A <- array(1:6000, dim = c(10, 20, 30))

res <- TT_SVD(A, ranks = c(1, 2, 2, 2, 1))

res_acc <- TT_SVD(A, epsilon = 1e-3)

store <- TT_SVD_reconstruct(res_acc)

TTSVD(A_tensor, accuracy = 1e-2) |> TT_SVD_reconstruct()

TT_SVD_reconstruct(TTSVD(A_tensor, accuracy = 1e-1))

nm_prod(res[[1]], res[[2]], 2, 1) |> 
  nm_prod(res[[3]], 3, 1) |> 
  nm_prod(res[[4]], 4, 1)
  
  
nm_prod(res_acc[[1]], res_acc[[2]], 2, 1) |> 
  nm_prod(res_acc[[3]], 3, 1) |> 
  nm_prod(res[[4]], 4, 1)
  

C <- A

r <- c(1, 2, 2, 1)






A_reconstruct <- 
  nm_prod(list_cores[[1]], list_cores[[2]], 2, 1) |> 
  nm_prod(list_cores[[3]], 3, 1)

A_reconstruct

(A - A_reconstruct)
```

```{r}
library("rTensor")
# Tensor data
dimnames(A) <- list(
    I=paste0("i", 1:4),
    J=paste0("j", 1:5),
    K=paste0("k", 1:6))

A_tensor <- as.tensor(A)
# TT-ranks
Ranks <- c(p=2, q=2, r=2)
# TTSVD
out.TTSVD <- TTSVD(A_tensor, Ranks)

out.TTSVD$`I-p` |> dim() #2 x 2
out.TTSVD$`p-J-q` |> dim() #2 x 3 x2
out.TTSVD$`q-K` |> dim() #2 x 4
#row x col




nm_prod(out.TTSVD$`I-p`, out.TTSVD$`p-J-q`, 1, 1) |> 
  nm_prod(out.TTSVD$`q-K`, 1, 1)


ttm(out.TTSVD$`I-p` |> matrix(nrow = 2), out.TTSVD$`p-J-q`, 1)

ttm(as.tensor(out.TTSVD$`p-J-q`), out.TTSVD$`I-p`, m = 1) |> 
  ttm(out.TTSVD$`q-K`, m = 3)

out.TTSVD$`p-J-q`

rTensor::ttm(out.TTSVD$`I-p`, out.TTSVD$`p-J-q`, 1)
```
